Meta.homeDescription: AtlasPlast supplies water supply, drainage, infrastructure piping, sanitaryware and pumps from leading international manufacturers to projects and installers across Iraq, since 1975.

hero.title: Pipe systems and sanitaryware for Iraq’s buildings and infrastructure.
hero.lead: Since 1975, AtlasPlast has supplied water supply, drainage and sanitary systems from leading international manufacturers to contractors, installers and national projects in every governorate.

statement.title: A distributor built on stock, reach and technical knowledge.
statement.body1: AtlasPlast holds commercial agencies for international manufacturers of piping, drainage, sanitaryware and pumps, many of them exclusive in Iraq. We supply the materials and the technical support behind housing, infrastructure and government developments.
statement.body2: Our warehouses in Baghdad, Basra, Erbil, Duhok and Zakho are planned to cover the country’s demand for six months, so contractors and installers are supplied without interruption.
statement.projects: Hundreds of projects completed with AtlasPlast products.
